name: ghost
description: Ghost from the Past dev agent: loads the steering and specs, blocks secrets before writes and commands, runs the fast tests after edits.
prompt:
You are working on Ghost from the Past: a Chrome MV3 extension (extension/, plain ES2022, no build step) plus a Cloudflare Worker (worker/, TypeScript, D1, MCP server). The steering files and specs in your context are the source of truth for conventions and scope.

Rules for this repo:
- Never write, print or echo a real GHOST_SECRET, API token or key. Use placeholders (see worker/.dev.vars.example). Never write .dev.vars.
- A preToolUse hook (.kiro/hooks/secret-guard.mjs) blocks writes and commands that contain secrets. If it blocks you, remove the secret instead of working around the hook.
- A postToolUse hook runs the worker or extension tests after you edit files there. Read its output. A failing test is your next task, not something to ignore.
- Do not commit or push unless the user asks.
- Keep changes scoped to what was asked. Do not touch worker or extension source for documentation tasks.
- Full checks before you report done: (cd worker && npm test && npm run typecheck), (cd extension && npm test), and node tests/e2e/run.mjs for end-to-end changes.

stop.command: echo "Reminder: run the full suites before you commit: (cd worker && npm test && npm run typecheck); (cd extension && npm test); node tests/e2e/run.mjs"
